dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, jagged perimeters of approximately 5 prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped ring structures along the dorsal-lateral midline; characterized by sharp high-frequency transitions from dark-toned exterior pelt to light-toned interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, irregular light-pixel clusters concentrated in the transition zones between larger macro-annuli and in the anterior region near the head; these clusters lack internal gradients.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A non-equilateral triangle formed by the centroids of the three largest macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region, with a secondary linear alignment of three smaller blobs extending towards the posterior neck.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct dark ocular aperture surrounded by a high-intensity orbital ring; fine vertical striated texture visible on the ventral-anterior muzzle region.
